role_summary: German investor (Forbes: ~US$1.2B net worth, 2025). Founder of Apeiron Investment Group (family office, ~US$3.5B AUM). Seed investor (2016/2017) and long-time ~20-28% shareholder in Compass Pathways (COMP360 psilocybin; Nasdaq IPO Sept 2020). Co-founder (2018) and chairman of atai Life Sciences (Nasdaq IPO June 2021), which merged with Beckley Psytech in Nov 2025 to form AtaiBeckley (BPL-003 5-MeO-DMT, VLS-01 DMT, EMP-01 R-MDMA); on 2026-07-16 AtaiBeckley agreed to be acquired by Eli Lilly for US$6.75/share cash (~US$2.8B) plus CVRs up to US$2.50/share (total up to ~US$3.8B), closing expected Q3 2026; Angermayer holds ~15% (~US$360M). Public voice: X (@C_Angermayer), LinkedIn, Substack (christianangermayer.substack.com), conference panels (Milken, PSYCH, Wonderland, MAHA summit), podcasts. Also co-founder of the Enhanced Games and a crypto/longevity investor.

predictions.quote: PARAPHRASE: In 2018, Angermayer predicted FDA approval of COMP360 for TRD by 2021.
predictions.paraphrase: Compass Pathways' psilocybin (COMP360) would win FDA approval for treatment-resistant depression by 2021.
predictions.source_title: The shifting fortunes of corporate psychedelia (Finance and Society, Cambridge), citing E. Brodwin, Business Insider, 3 Oct 2018
predictions.resolution_note: No psychedelic was approved by 2021. As of 2026-09 COMP360 is still in a rolling NDA submission with completion targeted Q4 2026 and launch H1 2027.

predictions.quote: r-ketamine hopefully on the market...for the treatment of depression
predictions.paraphrase: atai's first product to reach the market would be R-ketamine (Perception Neuroscience) for depression.
predictions.source_title: The Tim Ferriss Show #377 transcript: Psychedelics panel at the 2019 Milken Global Conference (recorded late Apr/1 May 2019; published 2019-07-17)
predictions.resolution_note: atai's PCN-101 (R-ketamine) missed its primary endpoint in Phase 2a in Jan 2023 and was deprioritised; it never reached the market.

predictions.quote: PARAPHRASE: atai is 'some years away' from its first potential approval.
predictions.paraphrase: atai's first drug approval is several years beyond 2021.
predictions.source_title: atai founder: IPO funds will help trials of psychedelic medical products (Seeking Alpha, reporting CNBC Squawk Box interview on IPO day)
predictions.resolution_note: No atai/AtaiBeckley product approved through 2026-09; lead asset BPL-003 entered Phase 3 in Q2 2026 with topline expected early 2029.

predictions.quote: In late 2021, Compass Pathways plans to release its phase 2b data, which I believe could be a great boost
predictions.paraphrase: Compass would report Phase 2b psilocybin data in late 2021 and it would lift the sector.
predictions.source_title: Christian Angermayer | Founder, atai Life Sciences (Psychedelic Finance interview; conducted after the June 2021 atai IPO, page dated 2023-07-06)
predictions.resolution_note: Compass reported Phase 2b topline on 2021-11-09 (primary endpoint met at 25 mg), but shares fell sharply on the release and psychedelic stocks declined through 2022, so the 'boost' did not follow. Interview month is approximate.

predictions.quote: Mehr als eine Milliarde Menschen haben Probleme mit der psychischen Gesundheit. Und Covid wird dazu führen, dass noch mehr Menschen Hilfe brauchen. Da entsteht ein Milliardenmarkt.
predictions.paraphrase: A multi-billion market for psychedelic mental-health medicines will emerge.
predictions.source_title: LSD, Ketamin, Mushrooms: Psychedelika erobern die USA (Handelsblatt)
predictions.resolution_note: Esketamine (Spravato) reached ~US$1.7B sales in 2025 and Lilly agreed to pay up to US$3.8B for AtaiBeckley in Jul 2026, but no classic psychedelic is on the market yet.

predictions.quote: PARAPHRASE: Angermayer bought 1.2m more atai shares, called atai 'the biggest entrepreneurial opportunity I have ever encountered as an investor', and said the weak share price offers ample opportunity.
predictions.paraphrase: atai shares at ~US$1.5-2 are a strong buy and will reward investors.
predictions.source_title: Why This Investor Is Buying More Than A Million Dollars Of A Biotech Company (Benzinga, 2023-04-05, citing his LinkedIn post 'Putting my money where my mouth is')
predictions.resolution_note: ATAI traded around US$1.5-2 in Mar 2023; Lilly bid US$6.75 cash plus CVR up to US$2.50 in Jul 2026; ATAI closed US$7.35 on 2026-09-11.

predictions.quote: on the cusp of MDMA being ideally medicalized next year
predictions.paraphrase: MDMA-assisted therapy (MAPS/Lykos) would be approved in 2024.
predictions.source_title: The Psychedelic Podcast (Third Wave) ep. 207: Democratizing Psychedelics (recorded at Psychedelic Science, June 2023; published Aug 2023)
predictions.resolution_note: FDA issued a Complete Response Letter to Lykos on 2024-08-09 and asked for an additional Phase 3 trial.

predictions.quote: the probability that these substances will be approved soon is very high
predictions.paraphrase: MDMA and psilocybin ('psilocybin soon to follow') would be approved within a short time.
predictions.source_title: The Psychedelic Podcast (Third Wave) ep. 207: Democratizing Psychedelics (recorded June 2023)
predictions.resolution_note: No psychedelic approved as of 2026-09, more than three years later; COMP360 psilocybin is under a CNPV rolling review with a decision expected Q4 2026-Q1 2027.

predictions.quote: I don't see at all why this would take overly long. I'm actually optimistic that the rollout success and the rollout speed will surprise everybody positively.
predictions.paraphrase: Clinical rollout of psychedelic therapy after approval will be faster than the field expects.
predictions.source_title: The Psychedelic Podcast (Third Wave) ep. 207: Democratizing Psychedelics (recorded June 2023)
predictions.resolution_note: No approval yet, so rollout cannot be measured; Spravato reached >100,000 US patients by 2025, which Angermayer later cited as the template.

predictions.quote: approval by the FDA of MAPS' MDMA product is expected in 2024
predictions.paraphrase: Lykos/MAPS MDMA therapy approved by the FDA in 2024.
predictions.source_title: atai Life Sciences (Christian's Substack)
predictions.resolution_note: FDA Complete Response Letter to Lykos on 2024-08-09.

predictions.quote: Phase 2b readout of BPL-003 in treatment resistant depression (TRD), anticipated in the second half of 2024
predictions.paraphrase: Beckley Psytech's 5-MeO-DMT Phase 2b topline would come in H2 2024.
predictions.source_title: atai Life Sciences (Christian's Substack)
predictions.resolution_note: Topline was announced 2025-07-01, six to twelve months later than guided (the trial met its primary endpoint).

predictions.quote: biotech will be one of the best performing asset classes this year

predictions.source_title: atai Life Sciences (Christian's Substack)
predictions.resolution_note: The XBI biotech ETF ended 2024 roughly flat while the S&P 500 rose about 23%; ATAI itself drifted from about US$1.6 to about US$1.4 over 2024.

predictions.quote: I am very confident in the potential of atai and am convinced that me and my fellow investors will be rewarded
predictions.paraphrase: atai shareholders will make money from current levels.
predictions.source_title: atai Life Sciences (Christian's Substack)
predictions.resolution_note: ATAI was about US$1.6 in late Feb 2024; Lilly bid US$6.75 plus CVR in Jul 2026; ATAI closed US$7.35 on 2026-09-11.

predictions.quote: IMO, there is still a strong chance that MDMA, with a properly conducted Phase 3 trial will get approved.
predictions.paraphrase: MDMA can still win FDA approval if a clean new Phase 3 is run.
predictions.source_title: X post by @C_Angermayer on the FDA advisory committee vote against Lykos/MAPS MDMA
predictions.resolution_note: FDA CRL of 2024-08-09 required an additional Phase 3; no MDMA approval as of 2026-09. The 2026-04-18 executive order prioritises breakthrough-designated psychedelics.

predictions.quote: If we succeed, and if we medicalise psychedelics, ATAI will be a double-, triple-digit billion-dollar company.
predictions.paraphrase: atai would be worth US$10B to US$100B+ once psychedelics are medicalised.
predictions.source_title: Meet the crypto-pioneering, biohacking, psychedelic-promoting billionaire who wants to reimagine the Olympics (Forbes, W. Yakowicz; text verified via Forbes Australia reprint of 2024-08-03)
predictions.resolution_note: AtaiBeckley agreed to sell to Eli Lilly in Jul 2026 for about US$2.8B upfront, up to US$3.8B with CVRs, before any approval; the standalone company will not reach a double-digit-billion valuation.

predictions.quote: Imo the sector presents a once-in-a-lifetime buying opportunity.
predictions.paraphrase: Small-cap biotech (including his psychedelic holdings) at all-time lows will strongly outperform as rates fall and deregulation arrives.
predictions.source_title: X post by @C_Angermayer on the small-cap biotech bear market
predictions.resolution_note: ATAI US$1.35 (2025-03-18) to US$7.35 (2026-09-11); CMPS US$3.22 to US$14.35 over the same period; Lilly bid for AtaiBeckley Jul 2026.

predictions.quote: That's the clearest public signal yet that the FDA is ready to act fast - if clinical data supports it.
predictions.paraphrase: The FDA under Makary will review and act quickly on psychedelic applications once data arrive.
predictions.source_title: X post by @C_Angermayer on FDA Commissioner Makary calling psychedelics a 'top priority'
predictions.resolution_note: On 2026-04-24 FDA granted COMP360 a rolling NDA review and a Commissioner's National Priority Voucher (1-2 month review), days after the 2026-04-18 executive order.

predictions.quote: Phase2b data for BPL-003 are anticipated for mid-2025
predictions.paraphrase: BPL-003 (5-MeO-DMT) Phase 2b topline by mid-2025.
predictions.source_title: atai acquires Beckley, establishing the undisputed leader in psychedelics (Christian's Substack)
predictions.resolution_note: Topline announced 2025-07-01; primary endpoint met, efficacy comparable to Spravato in one to two sessions.

predictions.quote: Once its therapeutics are approved, I believe atai will significantly outperform current analyst forecasts, both in sales and in long-term market leadership.

predictions.quote: End of P2b meeting with FDA anticipated in Q1 2026 ... Phase 2 data for R-MDMA (EMP-01) in SAD anticipated in Q1 2026
